items.title: Mrs. Charlotte Botney and Mrs. Bertha George McCullum Interview, 1960-10-16
items.q: I used to hear about Raymond Brown.

ctx.x: What did I know about? He was a fine drum roll guy. Yeah, Raymond.
I used to hear about Raymond Brown. And didn't Raymond live somewhere in college? Great time. Great time. I used to hear him. Like Oliver. I used to hear him talk about him.

Well. With George playing, little George, my brother. We were talking while you were talking. We were talking about the occasion of his wake. How the people walked. The wake was. The line was just about two blocks long. And you had to go. You just had. It's a continual session. And the boat of Steamer President was docked before the Canal Street at that time. And when all the musicians knocked off that night from the Steamer President and they all came in. But it was just a floor of musicians. And all night long.…
